name: Hanan
overview: The name Hanan appears multiple times in Scripture, referring to various individuals connected to God's people in different roles. These include descendants of Shashak and Azel, a Levite involved in teaching the law, and a chief who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah, highlighting faithful service in both worship and community leadership. Notably, Hanan is also identified among David's mighty men and as one of the Nethinim, illustrating a pattern of devoted service to God’s covenant community throughout Israel's history.
